items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
items.claim: The LORD speaks instructions to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: which I give to you for a possession
items.claim: The LORD gives the land of Canaan as a possession

items.quote: I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession
items.claim: The LORD places plague of leprosy in houses

items.quote: he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house
items.claim: A house owner reports suspected plague to the priest

items.quote: the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague
items.claim: The priest commands the house to be emptied before inspection

items.quote: the priest shall go in to see the house
items.claim: The priest enters and inspects the house

items.quote: he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall
items.claim: The priest examines plague marks appearing as hollow streaks in the wall, greenish or reddish and recessed

items.quote: the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days
items.claim: The priest seals the house closed for seven days

items.quote: the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look
items.claim: The priest returns on the seventh day to re-inspect

items.quote: if the plague be spread in the walls of the house
items.claim: The plague has spread throughout the walls

items.quote: the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is
items.claim: The priest orders removal of plague-infected stones

items.quote: they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city
items.claim: Infected stones are disposed of outside the city in an unclean place
items.place: an unclean place without the city

items.quote: he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place
items.claim: The priest orders the interior of the house scraped and contaminated dust removed outside the city

items.quote: they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place
items.claim: Contaminated dust is poured out and disposed outside the city
items.object: the dust that they scrape off
items.place: without the city into an unclean place

items.quote: they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones
items.claim: Replacement stones are installed where the removed infected stones were

items.quote: he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house
items.claim: The priest applies new mortar to replaster the treated house
